title: The toy was a choking hazard for our new puppy!
text: The toy, a thanksgiving pumpkin puzzle toy was completely unsuitable for our new Bernedoodle puppy. It’s squeak toy parts were  chewed to pieces in less than an hour. Since the stuffing emerged it was a choking hazard for our 15 week old puppy! The duck bone and 2 bags of treats certainly don’t come close to the prize of a monthly subscription! If there was a way to obtain a refund for an unsatisfactory product, I would certainly ask for that. I do not recommend this company!
label: negative
